full_judgment: 2. The respondent No. 1 instituted the above miscellaneous case for pre-emption of the case land measuring 9½ decimals of land under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act or in the alternative under section 24 of the Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act 1949, on the averments that the above land originally belonged to Yunus Mia Chowdhury, the opposite party No.2, who sold the same to Amina Khatoon, the predecessor of the opposite party No.1 by registered sale deed dated 27.7.87 which was entered in the volume on 23.2.88; Amina Khatoon is a stranger to the case jote; the notice of the above sale deed being collusively suppressed, the pre-emptor, a co-sharer of the case jote, had no knowledge of the above transfer and he came to know about the same only on 3.4.88 and thereafter on 11.4.1988 he filed this miscellaneous case.
